sources.title: NOAA OISST v2.1 monthly 1991-2020 SST climatology
NOAA OISST v2.1 monthly 1991-2020 sea-ice climatology

scope.interpretation: Broad tuning-informed reduced-sector temperature sanity check only. It is not independent pointwise SST skill, a regional forecast test, or quantitative validation.
scope.open_water_definition: OISST sea-ice concentration is converted to open_water_fraction=clip(1-ice_concentration,0,1) and included in the weights.
scope.sector_mask: The processor imports climate_model._atlantic_basin_fraction and applies the same smooth fractional Atlantic mask used by the model; non-Atlantic is ocean_fraction minus that Atlantic fraction.

mandatory_output_warning: Arctic open-water temperatures are reduced-sector diagnostics. The OISST ranges were inspected during tuning and are descriptive sanity bounds only; source files, release-time hashes, and processed observational summaries are not packaged, so this is not an independent or reproduced quantitative observational validation or a local, coastal, or regional forecast test.

reproduction.status: The deterministic processor and exact model mask are included. NOAA source files are not redistributed; therefore the release does not claim a reproduced numerical OISST validation. Downloaded source hashes and processed output must be generated locally before a reproducibility claim is made.
